schema: FMZ 5745 · Explicit public VIX input and independent order replay

notes.source_input: Archive default swap does not resolve in local Pine. The source exposes VIX Symbol as a configurable input, and CBOE:VIX is chosen for this research variant. All other settings and order conditions stay literal.
notes.join: Every UTC crypto day uses the latest Cboe OHLC whose session label precedes the chart's UTC date. The one-day release delay excludes incomplete same-date Cboe data. The last released value carries forward over weekends and holidays. Pine computes its 10-sample averages on the resulting chart-day sequence.
notes.venue: Native BTC chart plus independent ETH comparison at the saved daily cadence. 2019-12-23 08:00 to 2024-12-09 08:00 is interpreted in UTC, retaining 1,812 full chart bars within the saved window.
notes.fills_and_costs: Next daily open at the supplied historical cents precision. Quantity one base unit and default broker capital 1,000,000 USDT per independent market. Zero source fee for gross and 0.075% per-side fee overlay. Drawdown on settled equity. Funding and slippage are excluded from this research variant.
notes.verification: Uninstrumented and instrumented Pine orders and strategy output agree. An independent Decimal oracle verifies the joined values, both moving averages, all four conditions, position transitions, fill times and prices, and lot P&L.

coverage: Tested · Explicit official Cboe VIX input

Archived rule logic replayed with the author-configurable VIX Symbol set to official Cboe VIX. Strict lagged input join, Pine traces and independent order witness agree on both markets. Archived bare swap alias remains unidentified.
